note: Weather conditions come from the cited sources. How many hours of those conditions trigger an advisory is an Irminsul assumption (listed per rule), not an agronomic standard.

source.org: India Meteorological Department (IMD) rainfall intensity categories (per 24 h)
source.quote: Heavy 64.5-115.5 mm; very heavy 115.6-204.4 mm; extremely heavy >= 204.5 mm

rules.verification_note: IMD/MoES documents block automated download (HTTP 403); the bands were confirmed only via search snippets of several IMD documents. Owner to confirm against the PDF.
assumptions: Open-Meteo daily precipitation_sum is used as the 24 h amount for the farm's grid cell.

source.org: TNAU Agritech Portal — Late blight of potato

assumptions: Advisory when at least 10 of the next 48 forecast hours have RH > 90% and 10–25 °C (trigger count is Irminsul's assumption).

source.org: TNAU Agritech Portal — Early blight of potato
source.quote: Dry warm weather with intermittent rain. Poor vigor. Temperature: 25-30°C.

assumptions: Advisory when at least 12 of the next 48 hours are 25–30 °C and some rain (≥ 0.1 mm) is forecast in the window.

source.org: TNAU Agritech Portal — Late blight of tomato
source.quote: Cool nights, warm days and extended wet conditions from rain and fog; Optimum temp for sporulation is 18 - 22oC

assumptions: 'Extended wet conditions' approximated as RH ≥ 90%; advisory when at least 8 of the next 48 hours have RH ≥ 90% and 18–22 °C.

source.org: TNAU Agritech Portal — Early blight of tomato
source.quote: Warm, humid (24-29 degree C), rainy and wet weather.

assumptions: 'Humid' approximated as RH ≥ 80%; advisory when at least 12 of the next 48 hours have RH ≥ 80% and 24–29 °C and some rain is forecast.
